conclusion: No suitable public measurement window was found. No commit window is selected, and task 5 cannot proceed on public CI history alone.

method.manualInspection: gh run view <runId> --repo <repo> --log-failed, for every run whose Apex-test job concluded failure

whatWasRequired: A public Salesforce repository whose history contains Apex tests that PASSED at c^ and FAILED at c. Those pairs are the numerator of the false-negative rate.
findings: Job names were matched with /scratch|apex|test/i, which also matches the lint/jest job `format-lint-lwc-tests`. Every failure in apex-recipes, automation-components and easy-spaces-lwc was that job, not an Apex test job.
The only failing Apex-test jobs in the surveyed window were 4 runs of trailheadapps/coral-cloud scratch-org-test: 28972701191, 28972033224, 28944423511, 28939823573.

All four were inspected individually. All four failed during metadata deployment (Component Failures: FlexiPage Experience_Record_Page and Flow PersonalizedSchedule) and never reached the Run Apex tests step. None contains a Test Summary block. They therefore contain zero Apex test outcomes of any kind.
Across every repository surveyed, the number of runs containing a failing Apex TEST (as opposed to a failing job) is zero.
trailheadapps/apex-recipes was already measured at a 100% pass rate (docs/measurements, and docs/CORRECTNESS-PLAN.md 3a). This survey did not change that.
SalesforceFoundation/NPSP exposes no GitHub Actions runs with an Apex test job; its CI runs elsewhere, so its results are not reachable by this method.
limitations: GitHub Actions retains run history for a limited window (90 days by default). This survey observes only recent history and cannot see older failures.
Only the 30 most recent runs per repository were inspected.
A repository could contain Apex test failures that never ran in GitHub Actions at all.
consequence: Task 1.3 applies: the finding is recorded and no synthetic window is substituted. Tasks 2-4 build the harness; task 5 remains blocked on both an org and a window with a real numerator.
